Hi Professor Alvarez — I'd like to set up our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Two openings on my side that fit my other commitments:

- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Wednesday 15:00-15:30

Would either of those work for you? If not, tell me what times suit you and I'll fit around them.
Hi Professor Alvarez — I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Would Tuesday 14:10-14:40 work for you, or would you prefer Wednesday 10:30-11:00? I'm flexible on either.

Hi Professor Alvarez — I'd like to schedule our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Would either of these work for you?

- Monday 23 Nov, 10:00-10:30
- Thursday 26 Nov, 14:00-14:30

If neither fits, tell me a slot that does and I'll make it work.
Hi Priya — Monday 10:00-10:30 works. Booked: Monday, 10:00-10:30, 1:1. I'll see you then.
Hi Professor Alvarez — I'd like to set up our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Would Monday 14:00-14:30 or Tuesday 11:00-11:30 suit you? I can make another slot work if neither does.

Hello Professor Alvarez,

I'd like to set up our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Looking at my calendar, these slots are free:

- Monday 14:00-14:30
- Tuesday 15:00-15:30
- Wednesday 13:00-13:30

Would any of those work for you? If not, tell me a time that suits you and I'll fit around it.

Best,
Sarah
Perfect — Monday 10:00-10:30 it is. It's in my calendar. See you then!
Hi Professor Alvarez — I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Would Monday 10:00-10:30 or Thursday 14:00-14:30 work for you? Happy to fit another slot if those don't suit.

Hello Professor Alvarez — I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week (Nov 23-27). Looking at my own schedule, the slots I have free are:

- Monday Nov 23, 10:00-10:30
- Monday Nov 23, 14:00-14:30
- Thursday Nov 26, 10:00-10:30
- Thursday Nov 26, 14:00-14:30
- Friday Nov 27, 11:00-11:30

Does any of those work for you? If you'd rather suggest another time inside working hours, I'll make it fit on my side.

Thanks,
Hana

Hi John — thanks. Both of those clash for me: Tuesday 14:10-14:40 overlaps the thesis committee run, and Wednesday 10:30-11:00 overlaps grant writing. Two that are free: **Tuesday 11:00-11:30** or **Wednesday 15:00-15:30**. Tell me which and I'll book it.

Hi Omar — Monday 10:00-10:30 is already taken, and Thursday 14:00-14:30 clashes with the PhD 1:1 block. Free instead: **Thursday 10:00-10:30** or **Tuesday 15:00-15:30**. Say which and I'll put it in.
Wednesday 15:00-15:30 works on my side — please book it. Thanks!

Thanks, Professor. Both of those clash on my side: Thursday 10:00-10:30 runs into my CSE455 quiz section (09:00-10:20), and Tuesday 15:00-15:30 falls inside the CSE452 lecture (14:50-15:50).

Slots I have free next week: **Monday 10:00-10:30**, **Monday 14:00-14:30**, **Tuesday 11:00-11:30**, **Friday 11:00-11:30**. Any of those work for you?
Hi Maya — Monday 14:00-14:30 works. Booked: Monday, 14:00-14:30, 1:1. See you then.
Hi Sarah — Monday 14:00 is taken, so Wednesday 13:00-13:30 it is. Booked: Wednesday, 13:00-13:30, 1:1. See you next week.
Hi Diego — Monday 10:00-10:30 has gone and Thursday 14:00-14:30 clashes with my PhD 1:1 block. I've booked us **Wednesday 10:00-10:30**. If that truly doesn't work, tell me and we'll move it.

Hi Hana — thanks for the list, but every slot on it clashes: Monday 10:00 and Monday 14:00 are taken, Thursday 10:00 is spoken for, Thursday 14:00 overlaps my PhD 1:1 block, and Friday is fully booked. Nothing else free on Monday or Friday. Free slots left: Tuesday 11:00-11:30, Tuesday 15:00-15:30 and **Wednesday 15:00-15:30**. I've held Wednesday 15:00-15:30 for you — say the word and it's confirmed (or pick one of the Tuesdays).
Thanks — but Wednesday 10:00-10:30 clashes with my study group (09:00-10:30). Could we do Wednesday 15:00-15:30 instead? Thursday 10:00-10:30 also works on my side if that's easier for you.
Wednesday 13:00-13:30 it is — it's in my calendar now. See you next week, and thanks for the quick reply.
Perfect — Monday 14:00-14:30 it is, I've put it in my calendar. See you then.
Booked: Wednesday 15:00-15:30, 1:1. See you next week, John.

Hana — John confirmed Wednesday 15:00-15:30 first, so that one is his. I've moved you to **Tuesday 15:00-15:30** (Tuesday 11:00-11:30 has just gone too). It's booked now; tell me if it clashes and we'll find another.

Hi Omar — Monday 10:00 and Monday 14:00 are taken, and Friday 11:00-11:30 falls inside my paper-review block. Tuesday 11:00-11:30 is free at my end, so I've **booked Tuesday 11:00-11:30** for us. If it clashes on your side after all, say so and we'll adjust.
Thanks — see you Wednesday.

Diego — Wednesday 15:00-15:30 has since gone to John, so I've moved us to **Thursday 10:00-10:30** (free at my end). Wednesday is clear of you now; the Thursday slot is booked. If it clashes, tell me.
Perfect, Tuesday 11:00-11:30 is free on my side too — it's in my calendar. See you then, and thanks for sorting it out.
Noted — I've asked whether Wednesday 15:00-15:30 works instead. I'll book whichever slot you confirm.
To be clear: Wednesday 15:00-15:30 is taken by John, so our slot is **Thursday 10:00-10:30** — that's the confirmed one. Nothing else needed from you.

Thanks for holding a slot — but I checked my calendar for next week and all three clash on my side:

- Tue 11:00-11:30 — I have Lunch 11:00-12:20
- Tue 15:00-15:30 — Research group meeting 14:50-15:50
- Wed 15:00-15:30 — my standing Advisor 1:1 block is 14:40-15:50 that day (is that the meeting you mean? if so it's already in my calendar and we don't need a second one)

If you meant a separate 30 minutes, could you offer another slot on Tue/Wed/Thu? The only one of the three I could free up is Tuesday 11:00, by moving my lunch — say the word and I'll book it.

Hana

Sorry — Tuesday 15:00-15:30 clashes too: my Research group meeting runs 14:50-15:50 that day, and I can't move that one.

Could you offer another 30 minutes? My only free windows next week are:
- Mon 10:00-10:30, 14:00-14:30
- Thu 10:00-10:30, 14:00-14:30
- Fri 11:00-11:30

...which are exactly the ones you said are taken on your side. If none of those can work, tell me which slot you'd like me to free up (e.g. part of my Tuesday lunch) and I'll make it fit.

Hana
Confirmed — Thursday 10:00-10:30 with you. It's on my calendar now. See you then.

Hana — you're right, and sorry for the churn. The 15:00-15:30 Wednesday slot was a separate 30-minute meeting; it's John's now, so nothing to do there.

Tuesday and Thursday are full at my end, and the only slot left on Tue/Wed/Thu is **Wednesday 10:00-10:30**, so I've booked you there. If that clashes on your side, tell me and I'll move you to Tuesday 11:00-11:30 instead (I'll free it for you).

Our messages crossed — see the note just above. Short version: **Wednesday 10:00-10:30** is booked for you (it's free on my side; your free-window list just didn't include it). If it clashes, the alternative is **Tuesday 11:00-11:30** — that one needs you to move your lunch, so only ask for it if Wednesday truly won't work.

Thanks — and sorry, our messages crossed.

Wednesday 10:00-10:30 does clash on my side: I have Focus: CSE444 project 09:00-10:20 and the Research group meeting 10:20-11:20 that morning.

So yes please, let's take the alternative: **Tuesday 11:00-11:30**. I'll move my lunch to 11:30-12:20 to make room — I've already put the 1:1 in my calendar for Tuesday 11:00-11:30, so we're set unless you tell me otherwise.

Hana
Confirmed on my side too — Tuesday 11:00-11:30, with my lunch moved to 11:30-12:20. See you then. Hana

Hana — confirmed: **Tuesday 11:00-11:30** is yours. One snag: that slot was Omar's, so I'm moving him to Friday 11:00-11:30. If for any reason it falls through I'll tell you straight away; otherwise see you Tuesday.

Omar — sorry for the churn. Hana's only remaining free window next week is Tuesday 11:00-11:30, so I've moved your 1:1 to **Friday 11:00-11:30** (one of the slots you listed as free; I've trimmed my paper review to make room). If Friday doesn't work after all, tell me and I'll find another.
Understood — Tuesday 11:00-11:30 it is. For what it's worth, Friday 11:00-11:30 is free on my side too (I only have Lunch from 11:30), so Omar should be fine there. See you Tuesday.
No problem at all — Friday 11:00-11:30 works for me and it's in my calendar now (Tuesday freed up). Good luck to Hana with her slot.
